scope: Twenty local FTS queries across the 28948-message downloaded index; 208 unique ranked results returned. No attachment inspection or game execution.

findings.summary: Check the indexed-MAT import path before changing a texture to cure a Blender transparency artifact.
A bake with no animation is a useful control for rig/rest-pose debugging.
Isolate scene state when KEY export says an existing node is missing.
Distinguish an animation editor's binding assumptions from a bad native animation.
For a second weapon attachment, distinguish the PUP role number from its mapped 3DO node.
Test attachment origins when evaluating pivot cleanup.
A hovering replacement actor with a much larger interaction envelope may be a template-size problem.
Using MP bodies as SP actors needs a spawn-count and weapon-state test matrix.
Correspondence-based native KEY editing is an alternative to a full modern rig pipeline.
Native animation can also be an input to a modern animation workflow.
